bio.text: Winston Jordan is an independent candidate for New Jersey's 12th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, with the campaign slogan "Get Money Out."
WHYY's voter guide says he was born in Brooklyn, New York, and lives in Hopewell Township, New Jersey.
He is a U.S. Army veteran and has worked as a computer systems analyst, engineer and IT executive.

sources.title: NJ election 2026: Voter guide for 12th Congressional District
